name: Manual Therapy & Joint Mobilisation
shortDesc: Hands-on work to restore joint play, release guarded muscle, and restore pain-free movement before loading begins.

name: Spine, Disc & Sciatica Rehabilitation
shortDesc: Disc, postural, and mechanical back pain treated with a graded plan that addresses why it keeps returning.

name: Sports Injury Rehabilitation
shortDesc: Return-to-play programmes for strains, ligament injuries, and overuse — measured against real milestones, not guesswork.

name: Post-Operative Rehabilitation
shortDesc: Structured recovery after knee, spine, and fracture surgery, sequenced strictly to the protocol your orthopedic surgeon signed off.

name: Bedside Home Physiotherapy
shortDesc: The same consultant clinical protocol delivered at your bedside across Noida Extension, Greater Noida, and nearby sectors.

name: Dry Cupping & Myofascial Suction
shortDesc: Silicone or plastic cups drawn onto the skin to lift tight fascia and guarded muscle — no incision and no heat.

name: Wet Cupping (Hijama)
shortDesc: Sterile cupping after shallow superficial micro-incisions so stagnant blood can be drawn out. One-to-one in a private room.

name: Fire Cupping & Thermal Therapy
shortDesc: Glass cups briefly warmed with flame and placed on the skin — gentle negative suction and penetrating heat combined.

name: Geriatric Mobility & Fall Prevention
shortDesc: Fall prevention, joint stiffness relief, and balance restoration designed around how older bodies actually recover.

name: Neurological Rehabilitation
shortDesc: Balance, gait, and everyday function rebuilt after stroke, facial palsy, or nerve compression, one repetition at a time.
